args: set -eu; issue="$(jq -r '.issue.number' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")"; export GH_TOKEN="$GITHUB_TOKEN"; body="IMPACT_WRITE_PROBE_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"; comment="$(gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${issue}/comments" -f body="$body" --jq .id)"; gh api --method DELETE "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/comments/${comment}" >/dev/null; printf "IMPACT_WRITE_MARKER repo=%s issue=%s comment_id=%s deleted=true`n" "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$issue" "$comment" > /tmp/impact-write-marker
